5,000 years of money in 45 seconds 💰⏳

Cattle, grain, salt and shells. Then the first stamped metal coins around 600 BC. China's government paper money in 1024. Sweden's central bank in 1668. Then cards, phones, and now bitcoin and digital currencies.

The form keeps changing, but every kind of money runs on one thing: trust. 🤝

▶️ Watch all nine stages in the full video on our YouTube channel (link in bio): https://youtu.be/aI3nDfGndlY

Education, not financial advice.
